title: Dasung Releases 25.3" Monitor- Paperlike 253 | First Look
summary: A short first look at Dasung's 25.3-inch Paperlike 253 e-ink monitor, edited from the company's own Weibo reveal video. Price and release date were not yet known.
why: Used as evidence that large e-ink monitors can handle video and scrolling, and as a pointer to Dasung as the main e-ink monitor maker.
